advancedtechnologyservices-advancedtechn.title: Maintenance Technician II
advancedtechnologyservices-advancedtechn.description: Founded in 1985, ATS is a company with a presence in the United States, Mexico and the United Kingdom. We are professionals in Industrial Maintenance and we make factories run better. Fundada en 1985, ATS es una empresa con presencia en los Estados Unidos, México y el Reino Unido. Somos profesionales en mantenimiento industrial y hacemos que las fábricas funcionen mejor. Principal Duties/Responsibilities: · Performs mid to expert level break-fix & preventative maintenance. This includes but is not limited to: observing devises in operation to location root cause of problem; dismantling devices to gain access to and remove defective parts; examining parts to detect imperfections; adjustment of functional parts of devices and control instruments; repair and/or replacement of defective parts; testing of device to observe performance; and performing tests for electrical circuitry and mechanical systems; reconditioning and repairing machine tools. · Identifies and sources parts, supplies and repair items as necessary. · Independently performs maintenance as per industry standards. · May be required to setup and operate multiple machining operations including but not limited to: lathe, drill press, grinder, and other metalworking tools to make and repair parts. May perform welding tasks. · Complies with 5S and housekeeping standards. · Drives and participates in CI activities - processes, results and cost savings. · Updates records and reviews CMMS history. · Troubleshoots and analyzes control systems to resolve software/ hardware and configuration problems. · Utilizes predictive maintenance technologies to collect equipment performance data. · Provides assistance to lower level technicians and leadership to small teams. Performs more advanced functions as a part of training and development. · Completes on-the-job and technical self-study programs for career development. · Follows all safety related policies, rules, regulations, technical instructions and guidelines. Situational awareness and identify unsafe behaviors and conditions. Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, & Behaviors Required: · High School Graduate or equivalent (GED). · Associates degree with a Technical focus and 3 years of related experience in general industry; or 5 years of related experience in general industry or successful completion of the ATS Technician Progression Program. · Understands electrical, mechanical, fluid power and control systems. Can analyze problems and perform repairs. · Must be able to use basic hand tools and specialized tools as appropriate · May be required to travel. Physical Demands and Working Conditions: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands/fingers to handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb, ascend/descend or balance to heights that may require a ladder or lift; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl in confined spaces; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move more than 50 pounds. The employee is regularly required to use close vision and color vision. The employee is occasionally exposed to outside weather conditions and risk of electrical shock. Work is typically performed in a factory environment and is usually very loud. In the factory environment, the employee may be exposed to hazardous materials and/or greasy or slippery factory floors. ​ ATS believes in fair and equitable pay. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. We also offer market leading benefit programs including Medical, Dental and Vision plans, PTO, a 401k retirement plans with employer matching, tuition reimbursement, and more. Pay Transparancy $30.28 — $38.72 USD ATS is committed to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment

assistworld-assist-world:lever:3b5129c4-.title: Senior Performance Ad Designer/Editor (Direct Response / E-commerce)
assistworld-assist-world:lever:3b5129c4-.description: About The Role NovaaLab is scaling rapidly, and our growth is directly fueled by our creative output. We are seeking a Senior Performance Video Editor & Ad Designer who lives and breathes direct-response marketing. Your mission is simple: conduct deep ad research, take raw assets, UGC, AI generations, and product footage, and engineer them from scratch into high-converting Meta Ads. You are not just a task executor; you are a creative scientist. We make psychologically engaging, scroll-stopping ads that drive immediate revenue. You will work closely with our creative strategists to research, create, analyze, iterate, and launch high volumes of winning creatives based on hard data. Core Responsibilities 1. Elite Ad Research & Creative Analysis ● The Motion Master: You are elite at using Motion or similar analytics tools to analyze creative performance. You don't wait for media buyers to tell you what's working; you live in the dashboards and pull your own insights. ● Metric Diagnosis: You possess an elite understanding of ad data. You know exactly how to diagnose a failing ad by reading Hook Rate, Hold Rate, Outbound CTR, and CPA, and you know exactly what visual levers to pull to fix them. ● Competitive Research: Conduct relentless, elite-level ad research. You know how to mine the Facebook Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, YouTube shorts, and competitor funnels to spot emerging trends, winning angles, and pattern-interrupt styles before they peak. 2. High-Volume Direct Response Ad Creation ● Ad Production: Create cohesive, high-converting static ads & video ads from the ground up using raw footage, UGC, AI-generated assets, and product B-roll. ● Mastering the Hook: Design scroll-stopping visual and auditory hooks for the critical first 3 seconds of every ad to maximize thumb-stop ratios. ● Pacing & Retention: Execute aggressive, fast-paced editing styles designed specifically for social media feeds. You know exactly when a clip lingers too long and how to use punch-ins, B-roll cutaways, and transitions to keep viewer retention high. 3. Visual Polish & Sound Design ● Dynamic Typography: Create bold, highly readable, native-looking text overlays and captions that drive the narrative even when the sound is off. ● Audio Engineering: Apply high-impact sound design (whooshes, pops, risers) and mix AI voiceovers (ElevenLabs) with background tracks to elevate the production value and drive emotional engagement. 4. Rapid Iteration & Data-Driven Adjustments ● Versioning: Take baseline winning ads and rapidly produce variations (testing new hooks, new CTAs, different voiceovers, or pacing changes) to combat ad fatigue and scale spend. ● Surgical Fixes: Use your Motion data insights to execute immediate, surgical creative solutions to fix drop-off points mid-funnel. 5. Asset Utilization ● Seamlessly utilize the modular templates, 3D anatomical animations, and asset libraries built by our Systems Architects to maintain brand consistency while creating at maximum speed.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:63b1095c-e99a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Acquisitions Manager | Home Buying Specialist based in United States. This is a high-impact sales role at the heart of a fast-moving real estate acquisitions team. You’ll connect directly with property sellers, build trust, assess opportunities, and guide deals from initial conversation through closing. You’ll work closely with marketing and closing teams while staying informed on market trends and property values. With uncapped commission potential and structured onboarding support, the position rewards initiative, strong negotiation, and consistent performance. It’s a fully remote opportunity for an ambitious closer who wants significant ownership and earning potential. Engage with seller leads generated through marketing initiatives, building rapport and establishing trust throughout the sales process. Assess properties and gather relevant information to support accurate valuations and informed acquisition decisions. Lead negotiations with property sellers, applying strong sales and persuasion skills to structure mutually beneficial agreements. Manage deals from initial qualification through contract execution, ensuring a smooth transition to the closing team. Collaborate closely with marketing, acquisitions, and closing colleagues to keep transactions progressing efficiently. Maintain strong communication with sellers throughout the process, delivering a professional and memorable experience. Monitor real estate market conditions, trends, and relevant opportunities to strengthen competitiveness and decision-making. Requirements: At least 2 years of successful high-ticket sales experience , ideally within real estate, luxury goods, financial services, or another high-value sales environment. A proven track record of exceeding sales targets and consistently closing complex or high-value deals. Strong negotiation, objection-handling, and closing abilities, with confidence guiding prospects toward a decision. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, combined with a natural ability to establish rapport and build trusted relationships. Strong self-motivation and a results-oriented mindset, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment. Comfortable using CRM platforms and modern sales technology to manage leads, follow-ups, and opportunities. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams while maintaining ownership of your deals. A real estate license is welcome but not required . Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills are a plus. Benefits: Base salary of approximately $2,000–$3,000 USD per month.
